# 5 Visualization.
```{r}
#acts = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/classical_monocytes_acts.rds")
acts = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/pbmc_acts.rds")


# Extract norm_wmean and store it in tfswmean in pbmc
data[['tfswmean']] = acts %>%
  filter(statistic == 'norm_wmean') %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', names_from = 'condition',
              values_from = 'score') %>%
  column_to_rownames('source') %>%
  Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
DefaultAssay(object = data) = "tfswmean"

# Scale the data
data = ScaleData(data)
data@assays$tfswmean@data = data@assays$tfswmean@scale.data
```

# Test significance.
```{r}
mono_df = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/classical_monocytes_df.rds")
pbmc_df = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/pbmc_df.rds")


get_statistics = function(gene, df, CHIP_group) {
  gene_data = df %>% filter(source == gene)
  results = t.test(gene_data %>% filter(cluster == CHIP_group) %>% pull(score), gene_data %>% filter(cluster == "Control") %>% pull(score))
  return(list(results$statistic, results$p.value, results$conf.int[1], results$conf.int[2], results$stderr))
}

format_results = function(results, tfs) {
  results_df = do.call(rbind, results) %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(results_df) = c("T_statistic", "p_value", "conf_int_low", "conf_int_high", "std_err")
  rownames(results_df) = tfs
  
  results_df$adj_p = p.adjust(results_df$p_value, method = "BH")
  results_df$T_statistic = as.numeric(gsub("c\\(t = ([0-9.]+)\\)", "\\1", results_df$T_statistic))
  results_df$p_value = as.numeric(results_df$p_value)
  results_df$conf_int_low = as.numeric(results_df$conf_int_low)
  results_df$conf_int_high = as.numeric(results_df$conf_int_high)
  results_df$std_err = as.numeric(results_df$std_err)

  return(results_df %>% rownames_to_column("gene"))
}

# Stats for monocytes.
mono_tfs = unique(mono_df$source)
tet2_mono_results = lapply(mono_tfs, get_statistics, mono_df, "TET2")
tet2_mono_df = format_results(tet2_mono_results, mono_tfs)
write_tsv(tet2_mono_df, "tables/tf_activity/tet2_mono_significance.tsv")

dnmt3a_mono_results = lapply(mono_tfs, get_statistics, mono_df, "DNMT3A")
dnmt3a_mono_df = format_results(dnmt3a_mono_results, mono_tfs)
write_tsv(dnmt3a_mono_df, "tables/tf_activity/dnmt3a_mono_significance.tsv")

# Stats for pbmcs.
pbmc_tfs = unique(pbmc_df$source)
tet2_pbmc_results = lapply(pbmc_tfs, get_statistics, pbmc_df, "TET2")
tet2_pbmc_df = format_results(tet2_pbmc_results, pbmc_tfs)
write_tsv(tet2_pbmc_df, "tables/tf_activity/tet2_pbmc_significance.tsv")

dnmt3a_pbmc_results = lapply(pbmc_tfs, get_statistics, pbmc_df, "DNMT3A")
dnmt3a_pbmc_df = format_results(dnmt3a_pbmc_results, pbmc_tfs)
write_tsv(dnmt3a_pbmc_df, "tables/tf_activity/dnmt3a_pbmc_significance.tsv")

```

```{r}
erythroid_genes = read_tsv("input_data/erythroid_differentiation.tsv", skip = 2, col_names = "gene")
myeloid_up_genes = read_tsv("input_data/myeloid_differentiation_up.tsv", skip = 2, col_names = "gene")

mono_p_values_tet2 = read_tsv("tables/tf_activity/tet2_mono_significance.tsv")

pbmc_p_values_tet2 = read_tsv("tables/tf_activity/tet2_pbmc_significance.tsv")
pbmc_p_values_dnmt3a = read_tsv("tables/tf_activity/dnmt3a_pbmc_significance.tsv")

mono_p_values = rbind(mono_p_values_tet2 %>% mutate(CHIP = "TET2"), mono_p_values_dnmt3a %>% mutate(CHIP = "DNMT3A"))
pbmc_p_values = rbind(pbmc_p_values_tet2 %>% mutate(CHIP = "TET2"), pbmc_p_values_dnmt3a %>% mutate(CHIP = "DNMT3A"))

```


```{r}
make_tf_plot = function(df, geneset, color, p_values) {

  # Transform to wide matrix.
  activity_matrix = df %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(score)) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = 'cluster', names_from = 'source', values_from = 'mean') %>%
    column_to_rownames('cluster') %>%
    as.matrix()
  
  # Choose color palette.
  palette_length = 100
  my_color = colorRampPalette(c("white", color))(palette_length)
  my_breaks = c(seq(-0.6, 0, length.out=ceiling(palette_length/2) + 1),
                 seq(0.05, 0.6, length.out=floor(palette_length/2)))
  
  # Prep p-value annotations.
  p_value_matrix = p_values %>%
      pivot_wider(id_cols = 'CHIP', names_from = 'gene', values_from = 'adj_p')
  new_row = c("Control", rep("", ncol(p_value_matrix) - 1))
  p_value_matrix = rbind(p_value_matrix, new_row) %>% column_to_rownames("CHIP") %>% as.matrix()
  p_value_matrix[as.numeric(p_value_matrix) < 0.05] = "*"
  p_value_matrix[as.numeric(p_value_matrix) >= 0.05] = ""
  p_value_matrix[is.na(p_value_matrix)] = ""


  tfs_to_show = intersect(geneset, colnames(activity_matrix))

    # Plot.
  (plot = pheatmap(activity_matrix[c("TET2", "Control", "DNMT3A"), tfs_to_show], border_color = NA, color = my_color, breaks = my_breaks, cluster_rows = FALSE, display_numbers = p_value_matrix[c("TET2", "Control", "DNMT3A"), tfs_to_show]))
  
  
  return(plot)
}
```


```{r}
# We can also see what is the mean activity per group:
mono_df = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/classical_monocytes_df.rds")
pbmc_df = readRDS("rds_objects/tf_enrichment/pbmc_df.rds")

pdf("figures/tf_enrichment/monocytes_myeloid_heatmap.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
make_tf_plot(df = mono_df, geneset = c(myeloid_up_genes$gene, myeloid_down_genes$gene), color = "#C8133BFF", p_values = mono_p_values)
dev.off()

pdf("figures/tf_enrichment/pbmc_myeloid_heatmap.pdf", width = 6, height = 3)
make_tf_plot(pbmc_df, c(myeloid_up_genes$gene, myeloid_down_genes$gene), "#C8133BFF", pbmc_p_values)
dev.off()

pdf("figures/tf_enrichment/mono_endogenes_heatmap.pdf", width = 3, height = 3)
make_tf_plot(mono_df, endothelial_genes$gene, "#466F9DFF", mono_p_values)
dev.off()

```

# Check overall highest variance TFs across PBMCs.
```{r}
# Transform to wide matrix.
activity_matrix = pbmc_df %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = 'cluster', names_from = 'source', values_from = 'mean') %>%
  column_to_rownames('cluster') %>%
  as.matrix()

# Choose color palette.
palette_length = 100
my_color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "black"))(palette_length)
my_breaks = c(seq(-0.6, 0, length.out=ceiling(palette_length/2) + 1),
               seq(0.05, 0.6, length.out=floor(palette_length/2)))

# Prep p-value annotations.
p_value_matrix = pbmc_p_values %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = 'CHIP', names_from = 'gene', values_from = 'adj_p')
new_row = c("Control", rep("", ncol(p_value_matrix) - 1))
p_value_matrix = rbind(p_value_matrix, new_row) %>% column_to_rownames("CHIP") %>% as.matrix()
p_value_matrix[as.numeric(p_value_matrix) < 0.05] = "*"
p_value_matrix[as.numeric(p_value_matrix) >= 0.05] = ""
p_value_matrix[is.na(p_value_matrix)] = ""


tfs_to_show = pbmc_df %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score)) %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(std = sd(mean)) %>%
  arrange(-abs(std)) %>%
  head(20) %>%
  pull(source)

  # Plot.
(plot = pheatmap(activity_matrix[c("TET2", "Control", "DNMT3A"), tfs_to_show], border_color = NA, color = my_color, breaks = my_breaks, cluster_rows = FALSE, display_numbers = p_value_matrix[c("TET2", "Control", "DNMT3A"), tfs_to_show]))

```
